message: feat(unified): U06 S8与P8 provider、真实DMA及全局TEX状态
rulings: Complete U06 mechanisms, not a final application release. U22/U23 still bind actual RV32 ELF/catalog/CRT and build images.
Private provider contract is composed from fixed S8/P8 admission, native memory_ops and execution_ops; public old176B/new128B ABI and old program IDs unchanged.

DT compute-v2 opt-in, five exact SHA declarations and immutable root-owned files select exactly one provider before misc registration; P8 additionally requires frozen AXI diagnostics. No PL hash measurement claim.
Native public buffers have exact byte head/tail/padding guards. Trusted private CRT/stack guard groups cover up to64 strided per-hart ranges, bounded against retirement words and other guards.

One active GPU; exact IDLE and complete drains required, actual source/args/retirement readback, first partial/fault snapshot retained, no automatic START retry or reset. P8 indirect tables use real native transport with fixture MMIO/CDMA boundary.
ACK failure refreshes raw fault registers before quarantine; successful completion includes ACK verification metrics. Timers are nested, not additive exclusive intervals.
Host ordinary, ASan/UBSan, TSan, old eight target regressions and28 native lifecycle scenarios passed. Boundary raw37 is synthetic; gpu_raw_cycles=null.
Matching Linux5.4 module and AArch64 backend object compiled and archived; parent .config and Module.symvers unchanged, module not loaded.
All Ubuntu runs use fresh C three-lock/resource gates and append the shared coordination document. No cleanup, SD, board, reset or PL operation.
